title: You and your coach
subtitle: Chapter 8 of 9
instructions: Warm and plain spoken, like a friend showing you their app. Brisk and light on its feet, keeping things moving, but never rushed or clipped. No salesy lift at the end of sentences.

lines.text: Inviting your coach takes one link, and you choose whether they see a single match or everything you play.
They open the same points you do, in the same order, with the same score.
They can pause on any frame, draw straight onto it, and leave the note on that exact point instead of in a message thread you will lose.
They can also just hold the microphone and leave a spoken note on a point, which is quicker when they are courtside between games.
At the bottom of the match they can write up how the whole thing went and what you should work on next.
Everything they leave shows up in your journal alongside your own notes.
